insurance-baseline.addons_policy: Zero-depreciation, engine protect, RSA, return-to-invoice etc. are listed separately as optional add-ons and never part of the baseline.
insurance-baseline.ev_tp_note: Separate kW-based TP slabs exist for EVs but were not verified in P0; the engine refuses to estimate EV insurance (dealer must enter it) - error INSURANCE_ESTIMATE_UNAVAILABLE.
insurance-baseline.formula: premium = OD_1yr + TP_3yr + GST; OD_1yr = IDV x od_rate_bp; IDV = ex_showroom x (10000 - depreciation_bp) / 10000; GST = (OD + TP) x gst_bp. Each step rounded half up to the whole rupee.
insurance-baseline.gst_note: 18 % GST on motor insurance premium; not re-verified after the 2025 GST rate changes (which exempted individual life/health policies, not motor).
insurance-baseline.idv_depreciation_note: 5 % for vehicles not older than 6 months per the India Motor Tariff depreciation schedule as commonly applied by insurers; schedule not re-read from a primary source in P0.
insurance-baseline.label: ESTIMATE
insurance-baseline.od_rate_note: Own-damage premium is priced by each insurer (no single published tariff); 2.00 % of IDV is a placeholder chosen for comparability, not a market rate. It only matters when a dealer gives no insurance figure; ranking uses the dealer's own figure only when it declares exactly this baseline cover and is binding (AMENDMENT-004).
insurance-baseline.tp_note: Two 2026 insurer-aggregator pages agree on these 3-year figures; the IRDAI notification itself was not read. A different figure (Rs 9,435) for 1000-1500 cc circulates but no source was found for it.

rto.slab_semantics: A slab applies when base <= upto_paise (inclusive upper bound); upto_paise null = no upper bound. Base = vehicle price (ex-showroom minus discount) (ASSUMPTION Q-015).

tcs.compared_amount: Sale consideration of the vehicle = ex-showroom price (GST-inclusive invoice value of the vehicle) minus the dealer discount on the vehicle. Excludes registration/RTO, insurance, accessories, warranty, fees (ASSUMPTION Q-001).
tcs.creditable: Generally creditable against the buyer's income-tax liability (PLAN §2.4 framing). Shown as 'estimated net cost' only, with an explanation; not tax advice.
tcs.evidence_note: Statutory text read from a third-party copy of the Act (eztax.in); the official incometaxindia.gov.in page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the official page is listed but its text was not read directly. Commencement date confirmed from the CBDT press release title and multiple reports.
open_points: Whether GST is included in 'sale consideration' for the threshold has no post-GST CBDT clarification found (EY alert, Apr 2025). Pre-GST CBDT FAQ treated the limit as inclusive of VAT. Convoy uses the GST-inclusive vehicle price (Q-001).
tcs.pan_not_furnished: UNVERIFIED: a higher rate applies when the buyer's PAN is not furnished; rate not verified in P0. The engine assumes PAN furnished and the UI says so.
tcs.per: Per vehicle sale (one buyer, one vehicle per booking in Convoy)
tcs.prior_law: Sales before 2026-04-01: section 206C(1F) of the 1961 Act, same 1% and 'exceeding ten lakh rupees' wording (CBDT Circular 22/2016 Q&A).
tcs.provision: Section 394(1), Table, Sl. No. 6 (formerly section 206C(1F) of the Income-tax Act, 1961)
tcs.rounding: Round half up to the nearest whole rupee (ASSUMPTION Q-002; the Act does not fix TCS rounding at collection).
